d.why: On screen only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Weapon X, Lies and Video Tape' (later only recap and mention); she lures Logan to the Weapon X ruins and the episode is about their faked love, and she is Wolverine's partner.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'The Lotus and the Steel', where his refusal to pay the Silver Samurai's tribute and rallying of the village drives the conflict and decides how it ends.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Secrets, Not Long Buried', where he is the episode's villain who has taken over Skull Mesa.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'The Lotus and the Steel', where he is one of the Silver Samurai's biker henchmen who threatens Soichi; the Samurai is the villain.
Really on screen only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Weapon X, Lies and Video Tape' (just a vision earlier), where he is the episode's antagonist, the Weapon X robot that hunts Logan's group.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Secrets, Not Long Buried', where he is the missing old friend Cyclops comes to find, Solarr's paralyzed victim, and he decides the town will judge Solarr.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Descent', where he is one of several captives Essex shows off, briefly comforted by James Xavier in a story about Essex and Xavier.
Appears in X-Men: The Animated Series and in several X-Men '97 episodes across both seasons.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Repo Man', where he is the episode's antagonist who captures Wolverine for Department H; he is also Heather Hudson's husband and Alpha Flight's leader.
Fully on screen only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Family Ties' (just a vision cameo in 'Repo Man'), where her hunt for Magneto drives the plot; she is Magneto's daughter and Quicksilver's twin.
Appears in both parts of X-Men: The Animated Series 'The Phalanx Covenant'.
Appears in three X-Men: The Animated Series episodes: two parts of 'The Phoenix Saga' and one of 'The Dark Phoenix Saga'.

Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Secrets, Not Long Buried', where he is a Solarr henchman who downs Cyclops' plane and then switches sides at the end, while the townsfolk's uprising decides the outcome.
Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'Jubilee's Fairytale Theater', where the fairy-tale wizard has one short scene telling Jubilee she is the key to the crystal.

Only in X-Men: The Animated Series 'The Lotus and the Steel', where the village elder has a few lines urging the village to keep paying tribute; his 'boss' tie is to Kisara, another one-episode guest, so it does not count.
Appears in both parts of X-Men: The Animated Series 'Savage Land, Strange Heart' (she is on screen and speaks in Part Two).
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 1, 3 and 6, and is Lonnie Lincoln's brother.
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 2, 4 and 9 as Peter's Oscorp supervisor.
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 4, 5 and 7 as a 110th Street Gang enforcer.
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 4, 5 and 6 as the Scorpions' lieutenant.
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 1 and 6 as Peter and Lonnie's teacher.
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man episodes 6 (the gala) and 8 (Otto's arrest).
Appears in Your Friendly Neighborhood Spider-Man 'The Unicorn Unleashed!', 'Duel With the Devil' and 'Tangled Web' (by video call) as Otto's assistant.
